source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of a monastic patchwork kesa robe sewn from rectangular brick-bond panels (four columns by four rows) of hand-spun saffron-dyed cotton (#d4881c, #c07414) and deep maroon yak wool (#681a20) joined by raised indigo-blue sashiko running stitches (#244878), crossed by a horizontal woven border repeating the Order's Hourglass-inside-an-Eight-Spoked-Wheel emblem in burnished gold (#c8a030) and glowing temporal teal (#20a8b4), whole wheels inside seams. Full colour.
